style: Hand-painted stylized game-art surface in the exact painting style of the supplied environment concept: broad posterized color patches, angular brush shapes, restrained wear, sparse bold detail, no photorealism.
common: The WHOLE square is filled by the flat surface, viewed perfectly straight-on. No object, no silhouette, no outline, no border, no frame, no perspective, no vignette, no gradient from lighting, no cast shadow, no specular highlight, no text or labels, no characters. Even flat albedo only. Seamless tiling: left/right and top/bottom edges must match. Generate exactly one square image and save nothing else.

teal_iron.text: ONE seamless square base-color texture of the dusty teal-gray riveted boiler iron from the supplied concept (the skin of the large boiler): muted dark teal-gray iron, broad irregular painted patches that are slightly lighter and darker teal, scattered orange-brown rust flecks and a few soft vertical rust drip streaks, a few small dark pits. No rivets, no seams, no plates, no gauge, no valve.

red_paint.text: ONE seamless square base-color texture of the worn red paint on the valve hand wheels in the concept: deep saturated brick-red enamel with broad darker maroon patches, lighter orange-red worn edges as small scuffs, a few tiny chipped specks showing dark metal. No wheel shape.

brick.text: ONE seamless square base-color texture of a SINGLE fired-clay brick face from the concept (not a wall of bricks): warm orange-red clay with broad painted patches of darker rust-red and lighter orange, a few small chips and soot specks. Uniform brick surface only: no mortar lines, no brick edges, no courses.

mortar_stone.text: ONE seamless square base-color texture of the pale gray-beige stone and mortar used for the post caps, door pillars and mortar joints in the concept: soft warm gray stone with broad angular painted patches, tiny dark nicks and a few faint cracks. Uniform surface only, no blocks, no joints.

flagstone.text: ONE seamless square base-color texture of the large worn flagstone floor slabs in the concept: warm brown-gray stone, broad hand-painted mottled patches, slightly lighter dusty scuffs, a few hairline cracks and chips, subtle darker staining. A single continuous slab surface: no slab joints, no gaps, no grout lines.

dark_oak.text: ONE seamless square base-color texture of the dark oak timber of the posts, beams and rails in the concept: deep warm brown wood with long broad vertical grain stripes painted as angular streaks, sparse knots, slightly lighter worn edges, no planks edges. Grain runs vertically.

pine_planks.text: ONE seamless square base-color texture of the lighter warm pine / ochre-brown board wood of the crates and landing deck in the concept: honey-brown wood, broad painted grain streaks running vertically, a few knots and nail-stain specks, subtle value variation. Wood surface only, no board edges.

plaster.text: ONE seamless square base-color texture of the warm tan-ochre lime plaster of the walls in the concept: mottled orange-tan plaster with broad cloudy patches of lighter cream and darker terracotta, tiny chips and hairline cracks. Uniform plaster surface only, no bricks, no timber.

black_iron.text: ONE seamless square base-color texture of the dark cast iron of the drain grate, bucket and hardware in the concept: very dark warm charcoal-brown iron with broad painted facets, a few soft rusty orange-brown flecks and lighter worn gray scuffs. Uniform metal surface only.

brass_cream.text: ONE seamless square base-color texture of the cream dial paper and brass trim of the pressure gauges in the concept: warm cream-ivory surface with soft tan staining and a few small darker specks and faint brass-colored patches. Uniform surface only, no numbers, no dial marks, no needle.

amber_glass.text: ONE seamless square base-color texture of the warm amber glow glass of the lanterns in the concept: luminous yellow-orange amber with broad painted lighter yellow and deeper orange cloud patches, tiny darker flecks. Uniform surface only, no frame, no bars.
